## 2. Elastic net regularization

```{r}
outcomes <- c("Total_IQ","PSI","VCI","Behavioral_regulation_Tscore","Metacognition_Tscore","Global_executive_composite_Tscore","Internalizing_Tscore","Externalizing_Tscore","Total_Tscore")
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # fixed seed for reproducibility of alpha/lambda selection and bootstrap

run_elastic_net <- function(df, outcome, alphas = seq(0,1,0.1), n_boot = 1000) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    select(all_of(outcome), AverageDS,
           lh_parstriangularis_area, lh_frontalpole_thickness,
           lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness, lh_superiorparietal_thickness,
           rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness, rh_superiorparietal_thickness) %>%
    drop_na()

  X <- model.matrix(
    as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ AverageDS + lh_parstriangularis_area + lh_frontalpole_thickness + ",
                      "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness + lh_superiorparietal_thickness + ",
                      "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness + rh_superiorparietal_thickness")),
    data = df_use
  )[,-1]
  y <- df_use[[outcome]]

  predictor_names <- c(
    "AverageDS",
    "lh_parstriangularis_area",
    "lh_frontalpole_thickness",
    "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness",
    "lh_superiorparietal_thickness",
    "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness",
    "rh_superiorparietal_thickness"
  )

  # Grid over alpha
  cv_results <- lapply(alphas, function(a) {
    cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = a, nfolds = 10, family = "gaussian",
              standardize = TRUE, type.measure = "mse")
  })
  names(cv_results) <- as.character(alphas)

  # Select best alpha by min MSE
  cv_summ <- purrr::map_df(names(cv_results), function(a) {
    cvfit <- cv_results[[a]]
    tibble(alpha = as.numeric(a),
           lambda_min = cvfit$lambda.min,
           lambda_1se = cvfit$lambda.1se,
           cv_mse_min = min(cvfit$cvm))
  })
  best_row <- cv_summ %>% arrange(cv_mse_min) %>% slice(1)
  best_alpha  <- best_row$alpha
  best_cvfit  <- cv_results[[as.character(best_alpha)]]
  best_lambda <- best_cvfit$lambda.min

  # Final fit + apparent R^2 (in-sample variance explained, NOT cross-validated)
  final_fit <- glmnet(X, y, alpha = best_alpha, lambda = best_lambda,
                      family = "gaussian", standardize = TRUE)
  r2_apparent <- final_fit$dev.ratio

  coefs_raw <- broom::tidy(final_fit)

  coefs <- tibble(term = predictor_names) %>%
    left_join(coefs_raw, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(estimate = ifelse(is.na(estimate), 0, estimate)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))

  # --- Bootstrap stability check (fixed alpha/lambda from original fit) ---
  n <- nrow(X)
  boot_coefs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = length(predictor_names),
                        dimnames = list(NULL, predictor_names))

  for (b in 1:n_boot) {
    idx <- sample(1:n, n, replace = TRUE)
    X_boot <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    y_boot <- y[idx]

    boot_fit <- tryCatch(
      glmnet(X_boot, y_boot, alpha = best_alpha, lambda = best_lambda,
             family = "gaussian", standardize = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(boot_fit)) {
      boot_tidy <- broom::tidy(boot_fit)
      est <- setNames(rep(0, length(predictor_names)), predictor_names)
      est[boot_tidy$term[boot_tidy$term %in% predictor_names]] <-
        boot_tidy$estimate[boot_tidy$term %in% predictor_names]
      boot_coefs[b, ] <- est
    }
  }

  boot_summary <- tibble(
    term = predictor_names,
    selection_freq = colMeans(boot_coefs != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    boot_median = apply(boot_coefs, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    boot_q025 = apply(boot_coefs, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    boot_q975 = apply(boot_coefs, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  list(
    outcome = outcome,
    best_alpha = best_alpha,
    best_lambda = best_lambda,
    r2_apparent = as.numeric(r2_apparent),
    coefs = coefs,
    cv_table = cv_summ,
    boot_summary = boot_summary
  )
}

results_list <- lapply(outcomes, function(o) run_elastic_net(FINAL, o))

# Summarize outcome models
summary_enet <- tibble(
  outcome = sapply(results_list, `[[`, "outcome"),
  r2_apparent = sapply(results_list, `[[`, "r2_apparent"),
  best_alpha = sapply(results_list, `[[`, "best_alpha"),
  lambda      = round(sapply(results_list, `[[`, "best_lambda"), 3)
) %>% arrange(desc(r2_apparent))

# Coefficient table (unchanged structure)
coef_table <- map_df(results_list, function(res) {
  res$coefs %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = res$outcome,
      Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      Lambda = round(res$best_lambda, 3),
      Alpha = res$best_alpha
    ) %>%
    select(Outcome, term, Estimate, Alpha, Lambda)
})

# New: bootstrap stability table across all outcomes
boot_table <- map_df(results_list, function(res) {
  res$boot_summary %>% mutate(Outcome = res$outcome) %>%
    select(Outcome, term, selection_freq, boot_median, boot_q025, boot_q975)
})

coef_table
boot_table
summary_enet
```

## 3. Figures

```{r}
coef_table <- read.csv("Results/Elastic_Net_Review/all_coefficients.csv")
```

```{r}
names_regions <- c(
  AverageDS = "Absolute deviation burden",
  lh_superiorparietal_thickness = "Left superior parietal (CT)",
  rh_superiorparietal_thickness = "Right superior parietal (CT)",
  lh_parstriangularis_area =  "Left pars triangularis (SA)",
  lh_frontalpole_thickness =  "Left frontal pole (CT)",
  rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness = "Right caudal middle frontal (CT)",
  lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness = "Left lateral orbitofrontal (CT)"
)
```

```{r}
lollipop_df <- coef_table %>%
  filter(Outcome %in% c("Total_IQ", "PSI", "VCI")) %>%
  left_join(
    boot_table %>% rename(Outcome_orig = Outcome),
    by = c("Outcome" = "Outcome_orig", "term")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = recode(Outcome, "Total_IQ" = "FSIQ"),
    term = fct_relevel(
      term,
      "AverageDS",
      "lh_parstriangularis_area",
      "lh_frontalpole_thickness",
      "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness",
      "lh_superiorparietal_thickness",
      "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness",
      "rh_superiorparietal_thickness"
    ),
    term = fct_rev(term),
  )

lolliplot <- ggplot(lollipop_df, aes(y = term, x = Estimate, color = Outcome)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = boot_q025, xmax = boot_q975),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    height = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "FSIQ" = "#f18701",
      "PSI"  = "#7678ed",
      "VCI"  = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = names_regions) +
  labs(
    x = "Elastic net coefficient",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
lolliplot
```

## 3. Predictor correlations

```{r}
vars_for_corr <- FINAL %>%
  select(AverageDS,
         lh_parstriangularis_area,
         lh_frontalpole_thickness,
         lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness,
         lh_superiorparietal_thickness,
         rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness,
         rh_superiorparietal_thickness) %>%
  rename(!!!setNames(names(names_regions), names_regions))  # apply your readable labels

cor_matrix <- cor(vars_for_corr, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
round(cor_matrix, 2)
```

```{r}
cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix))
names(cor_long) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")

corplot <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0D0887", mid = "white", high = "#F00000",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(fill = "r")
corplot
```
